first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, while two inherited findings indicate that reducing signup friction and shortening onboarding improved activation, completion, and time-to-value. This is more aligned with sustainable revenue than pricing, whose known retention decline remains unresolved. Verify the two directly relevant records before testing, while monitoring qualified activation and downstream retention rather than completion alone.
